title: [Bug]: MultimodalConversableAgent iostream fails to serialize PIL.Image
body: ### Describe the bug Bug report from [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1153072414184452236/1212552055642660935/1341360595739475969) ### Steps to reproduce ```python import os from websockets.sync.client import connect as ws_connect import autogen from autogen.io.websockets import IOWebsockets from autogen.agentchat.contrib.multimodal_conversable_agent import MultimodalConversableAgent config_list = [ { "api_type": "openai", "model": "gpt-4o", "api_key": os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"] } ] def on_connect(iostream: IOWebsockets) -> None: print(f" - on_connect(): Connected to client using IOWebsockets {iostream}", flush=True) print(" - on_connect(): Receiving message from client.", flush=True) # 1. Receive Initial Message initial_msg = iostream.input() print(f"{initial_msg=}") try: agent = MultimodalConversableAgent( name="visionAgent", system_message="""You are a helpful assistant capable of analysing images.""", llm_config={ "config_list": config_list, "stream": True, }, ) user_proxy = autogen.UserProxyAgent( name="user_proxy", system_message="A proxy for the user.", is_termination_msg=lambda x: x.get("content", "") and x.get("content", "").rstrip().endswith("TERMINATE"), human_input_mode="NEVER", max_consecutive_auto_reply=10, code_execution_config=False, ) print( f" - on_connect(): Initiating chat with agent {agent} using message '{initial_msg}'", flush=True, ) user_proxy.initiate_chat( agent, message=initial_msg, ) except Exception as e: print(f" - on_connect(): Exception: {e}", flush=True) raise e with IOWebsockets.run_server_in_thread(on_connect=on_connect, port=8765) as uri: print(f" - test_setup() with websocket server running on {uri}.", flush=True) with ws_connect(uri) as websocket: print(f" - Connected to server on {uri}", flush=True) print(" - Sending message to server.", flush=True) initial_msg = """What's the breed of this dog? .""" websocket.send(initial_msg) while True: try: message = websocket.recv() message = message.decode("utf-8") if isinstance(message, bytes) else message print(message) # if "TERMINATE" in message: # print() # print(" - Received TERMINATE message. Exiting.", flush=True) # break except Exception as e: print("Connection closed:", e, flush=True) break ``` ```console - test_setup() with websocket server running on ws://127.0.0.1:8765. - on_connect(): Connected to client using IOWebsockets - Connected to server on ws://127.0.0.1:8765 - on_connect(): Receiving message from client. - Sending message to server. initial_msg="What's the breed of this dog?\n](https://th.bing.com/th/id/R.422068ce8af4e15b0634fe2540adea7a?rik=y4OcXBE%2fqutDOw&pid=ImgRaw&r=0%3E)." - on_connect(): Initiating chat with agent visionAgent using message 'What's the breed of this dog? ](https://th.bing.com/th/id/R.422068ce8af4e15b0634fe2540adea7a?rik=y4OcXBE%2fqutDOw&pid=ImgRaw&r=0%3E).' - on_connect(): Exception: Unable to serialize unknown type: - IOWebsockets._handler(): Error in on_connect: Unable to serialize unknown type: Connection closed: received 1000 (OK); then sent 1000 (OK) ``` ### Model Used _No response_ ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Screenshots and logs _No response_ ### Additional Information _No response_
